= Golden Master Fixtures

This directory holds reference SVG output used by the spec suite to lock
in emfsvg's behavior against `libemf2svg`, the C reference
implementation.

== Layout

[source]
----
spec/fixtures/
  image1.emf                  # Sample EMF input (from emf/spec/fixtures/simple/)
  golden/                     # libemf2svg reference output
    EA-test-file-001.svg
    ...
    test-186.svg
  emfsvg_golden/              # emfsvg regression baseline
    EA-test-file-001.svg
    ...
    test-186.svg
----

There are 208 accepted EMF inputs, 21 corrupted inputs, and 416 committed
SVG outputs. `parity_manifest.yml` records every input and output SHA-256,
the external corpus revision, the fixed nine-file sample, and the historical
208/209/426 comparison-group composition. The 1,048 whole-suite count is
historical context; new setup checks increase the suite size.

== Materialize the external corpus

The corpus is test data, independent of the `emf` runtime installed by Bundler.
Use a separate checkout; do not change an upstream owner's active worktree.

[source,bash]
----
git clone https://github.com/claricle/emf.git /tmp/emfsvg-parity-corpus
git -C /tmp/emfsvg-parity-corpus checkout --detach a549346e4c4cacf9da6c86ab451a9f8401fa9672
export EMF_FIXTURE_ROOT=/tmp/emfsvg-parity-corpus
bundle exec rspec spec/parity_manifest_spec.rb spec/parity_corpus_spec.rb
bundle exec rspec spec/golden_spec.rb spec/round_trip_golden_spec.rb spec/compat_with_libemf2svg_spec.rb --dry-run
----

The resolver rejects a missing root, wrong revision, duplicate basename,
missing or unexpected file, changed bytes, incorrect counts, and inventory
digest drift. No empty corpus is accepted. All 229 inputs and 416 outputs
are checked before comparison collection.

== Provenance readiness

The manifest deliberately distinguishes verified inventory integrity from
unqualified runtime/native metadata and a verified deliberate current C pin.
The original historical C source identity remains unknown; current qualification
establishes reproduction of the accepted reference bytes, not historical recovery.
Run `bundle exec ruby scripts/check_parity_provenance.rb` to list unresolved
metadata. This currently exits nonzero; it does not verify actual backend
selection, loaded package identity, or native behavior.

Development currently uses the temporary Git runtime pin
`5c2c019138bab6f3c67f7602e8b410ba5a67c429`, separate from the corpus revision.
`spec/runtime_dependency_spec.rb` verifies the lockfile, loaded Git checkout,
and entry point independently. This is integration evidence; a containing
qualified released package is still required.

The companion `corpus-integrity` CI job checks the pinned inventory and setup
contracts. The complete native-selected `model-parity` job remains pending
verified upstream contracts, native artifacts, and a containing released `emf`
package. A corpus checkout cannot establish any of those runtime properties.

== Explicit live C audit

Set both `EMF2SVG_REF_PATH` to an executable wrapper and
`EMF2SVG_REF_LIB_DIR` to its library directory. There are no developer-machine
defaults. Missing setup and failed conversions produce actionable errors.

[source,bash]
----
export EMF2SVG_REF_PATH=/absolute/path/to/emf2svg_ref
export EMF2SVG_REF_LIB_DIR=/absolute/path/to/library-directory
EMFSVG_LIVE_REFERENCE=1 bundle exec rspec spec/fidelity_regression_spec.rb
bundle exec ruby scripts/run_emf_svg_compare.rb
----

The fidelity audit is excluded unless `EMFSVG_LIVE_REFERENCE=1`. Ordinary
compatibility assertions use committed artifacts and do not invoke C. The
manifest records verified provenance for the deliberate current C pin below.
Exact collection counts are not proof of byte parity.

== Qualified C reference

=== Build libemf2svg

The historical reference SVGs were reported generated with `libemf2svg` v1.8.1
on 2026-07-24, without an exact source commit or binary checksum. That original
builder identity remains unknown. On 2026-10-23, a deliberate exact source pin,
`ca88c51f2f86e4a885b6aa5280ce3e7419cb73e5`, was built in an isolated temporary
checkout and reproduced all 208 accepted C golden files byte for byte. The
manifest's `verified` status attests this current pin and build, independently
of the corpus and runtime pins. No committed golden file was regenerated.

Run the following in a fresh build directory; save the wrapper below as
`emf2svg_ref.c` in that directory.

[source,bash]
----
git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/claricle/libemf2svg.git source
git -C source checkout --detach ca88c51f2f86e4a885b6aa5280ce3e7419cb73e5
cmake -S source -B build -DLONLY=ON
cmake --build build --parallel 2
----

That produces `build/libemf2svg.dylib` (the library). The CLI binary
`emf2svg-conv` would also work but requires `argp-standalone` (not
shipped on macOS by default), so we use a tiny wrapper instead:

[source,c]
----
// emf2svg_ref.c — minimal CLI around emf2svg() for fixture generation
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "emf2svg.h"

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    if (argc < 3) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s IN.emf OUT.svg\n", argv[0]); return 2; }
    FILE *in = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    fseek(in, 0, SEEK_END); long size = ftell(in); fseek(in, 0, SEEK_SET);
    char *buf = malloc(size);
    fread(buf, 1, size, in); fclose(in);
    char *out = NULL; size_t out_len = 0;
    generatorOptions opts = { .nameSpace=NULL, .verbose=0, .emfplus=1,
                              .svgDelimiter=1, .imgWidth=0, .imgHeight=0 };
    int rc = emf2svg(buf, size, &out, &out_len, &opts);
    free(buf);
    if (rc != 1) { fprintf(stderr, "emf2svg failed: rc=%d\n", rc); return rc; }
    FILE *f = fopen(argv[2], "wb"); fwrite(out, 1, out_len, f); fclose(f);
    free(out); return 0;
}
----

Build the wrapper:

[source,bash]
----
cc -I source/inc -L build -lemf2svg emf2svg_ref.c -o emf2svg_ref
export EMF2SVG_REF_PATH="$PWD/emf2svg_ref"
export EMF2SVG_REF_LIB_DIR="$PWD/build"
DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="$EMF2SVG_REF_LIB_DIR" "$EMF2SVG_REF_PATH" INPUT.emf OUTPUT.svg
----

=== Build attestation and accepted-corpus qualification

The qualified build used arm64 macOS 26.5.1 (25F80), Darwin 25.5.0,
Command Line Tools SDK 26.2, Apple clang 17.0.0 (clang-1700.6.3.2),
CMake 4.2.3, Unix Makefiles with GNU Make 3.81, and pkg-config 2.5.1.
`CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE` was empty. `LONLY=ON`; `GCOV`, `UNITTEST`, `INDEX`,
`STATIC`, `FORCELE`, and `USE_SYSTEM_LIBUEMF` were `OFF`. No source patches,
dependency installs, or vcpkg bootstrap/toolchain were used.

Vendored fmem tree `0c943f0f2dd06d05a3fc83aa760d6d049ec54629` was built
with `BUILD_TESTING=FALSE`, `CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5` and default
build type. Vendored libuemf tree was
`c7e186baf5bae970776b245fcbdda0e6b56c0d89`. The unused, uninitialized vcpkg
submodule pin was `4f95fba7a7d1101bb8acdeb51e4609686449701e`.
System dependencies were PNG 1.6.58, FreeType 2.14.3 (pkg-config API version
26.6.20), Fontconfig 2.18.3, SDK zlib 1.2.12, SDK LibXml2 headers 2.9.13
(runtime linkage current version 10.9.0), and Darwin iconv.

The wrapper and library are Mach-O arm64 artifacts. The wrapper links
`@rpath/libemf2svg.1.dylib` (current version 1.8.1) without an `LC_RPATH`,
so direct invocation requires the explicit `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH` above.
The minimal wrapper has no version/help flags: `--version` and `--help` both
print usage and exit 2 after loading the library. Version 1.8.1 is established
by the pinned CMake source and linked library metadata.

Qualification first validated the manifest inventory and external corpus pin
with `ParityCorpus#verify!`, then invoked only the C wrapper for each of the
208 accepted inputs, sequentially, writing to a temporary output directory.
Every output was compared byte for byte and by SHA-256 to its manifest C
golden. No Ruby render batch or corrupt-input conversion was performed.
Each invocation used the public `BoundedConversion.run` helper with
`timeout_seconds: 30`, `rss_cap_mib: 512`, `as_cap_mib: 512`,
`grace_seconds: 1`, and `authoritative: false`. Host `ps` sampled RSS; macOS
address-space enforcement was unsupported. This accepted-corpus audit does
not qualify the separate native/resource contract.

All 208 subprocesses succeeded and matched. Maximum elapsed time was 0.222
seconds and maximum sampled RSS was 34,352 KiB. The manifest and all 416
committed SVGs retained their bytes, sizes, inodes and mtimes during the audit.
The local evidence was `/private/tmp/emfsvg-c-build-evidence.txt` and
`/private/tmp/emfsvg-c-reference-build/accepted-audit.json`; the latter records
every input/output/expected SHA, command and bound result, with SHA-256
`0ce6181ded818dd7dfe297faf6c62427a50a52474dfd44f11399c95c2a988709`.
These temporary paths describe the qualification session, not required fixture
locations. Binary identity is specific to this build environment; rebuilds
must record their own identities and repeat qualification before promotion.

=== Generate the reference set

[source,bash]
----
bundle exec ruby scripts/regenerate_golden.rb --check
# Intentional promotion after the reference provenance is verified:
bundle exec ruby scripts/regenerate_golden.rb --write
----

`scripts/regenerate_golden.rb` validates the pinned external corpus and explicit C tooling, then stages both:

* `spec/fixtures/golden/<name>.svg` from libemf2svg
* `spec/fixtures/emfsvg_golden/<name>.svg` from the current emfsvg

`--check` reports differences without changing committed files. `--write` requires
the manifest's `c_reference.status` to be `verified`, a full `source_revision`,
a `build_recipe`, and `binary_sha256` matching the explicit reference executable.
The deliberate current pin above satisfies the C metadata requirement; the
unknown original historical builder is not asserted as verified.
Promotion updates both artifact sets and their manifest digests together, using
a cooperative writer lock and rollback on ordinary failures. This does not
provide an atomic snapshot to concurrent readers or crash recovery.

=== Review and commit

[source,bash]
----
git diff spec/fixtures/
git commit spec/fixtures/
----

== Bounded subprocess checks

`spec/support/bounded_conversion.rb` requires explicit wall-time, RSS,
address-space and termination-grace limits. It runs one command in a child
process group and attributes failures to the supplied basename. Linux uses
child-only `RLIMIT_AS` and distinct `/proc` RSS/address-space measurements;
macOS supports RSS/time checks and rejects authoritative address-space claims.
An unavailable sampler fails before conversion.

Benign-child checks exercise process cleanup independently of the corpus.
The corrupted-corpus contract and calibrated Linux baseline still require
upstream diagnostic/resource contracts and native qualification; this helper
does not establish those guarantees.

== Runtime package inspection

Build and inspect the actual runtime archive separately from the corpus checks:

[source,bash]
----
bundle exec gem build emfsvg.gemspec --output /tmp/emfsvg.gem
bundle exec ruby scripts/check_runtime_package.rb /tmp/emfsvg.gem
----

The checker verifies the archive and complete file inventory, rejects reference
helpers and corpus files, and walks the installed runtime dependency graph. Its
JSON report records the archive checksum, packaged paths and resolved dependency
versions. This does not qualify parser provenance or native backend selection.

== Reproducibility

The reference set is deterministic given:

1. The exact libemf2svg source commit (record in commit message when
   regenerating after an upstream bump).
2. The exact emf gem fixture set (the EMF inputs themselves).
3. The exact emfsvg source (recorded by the matching commit on the
   emfsvg repo).

The emf2svg_ref wrapper passes `generatorOptions{nameSpace=NULL,
verbose=0, emfplus=1, svgDelimiter=1, imgWidth=0, imgHeight=0}` which
matches libemf2svg's defaults. Any change to these options would
produce a different golden set; do not silently change them.

== Current comparison gates

`spec/golden_spec.rb` collects 208 byte comparisons against `golden/`.
`spec/round_trip_golden_spec.rb` collects 208 exact byte comparisons against
`emfsvg_golden/` plus one sorted artifact inventory assertion.
`spec/compat_with_libemf2svg_spec.rb` collects 208 Ruby-to-C byte comparisons,
208 artifact digest/provenance assertions, nine fixed byte/structure comparisons,
and one sorted source/reference/generated-output digest assertion. These checks
have no known-divergence exemptions or comparison skips.

The strict contracts currently expose failures: the `image1` round trip differs
from its committed artifact. The deliberate C pin reproduces all 208 accepted
reference artifacts; the full Ruby conversion and round-trip batches remain
separate qualification work.

Regeneration validates setup before staging and rolls back ordinary promotion
failures. Verified reference provenance remains required before reference updates.
Use the deliberate exact C pin and build identity recorded above for reference
qualification; historical builder identity remains unknown.

== License

The EMF fixtures in the `emf` gem come from various sources (Microsoft
test vectors, Sparx EA, community-contributed test cases). See
the pinned corpus checkout's `spec/fixtures/` for any per-fixture licensing.

The SVG outputs in this directory are mechanical transformations of
those EMF inputs. `spec/golden_spec.rb` needs no C binary, but requires the explicitly
materialized external corpus. The complete suite is not yet hermetic.

libemf2svg is GPLv2; the wrapper script `emf2svg_ref.c` is also GPLv2
by inheritance. Neither is shipped with this gem. The SVG output of
running a GPLv2 program on independent input is generally not a
derivative work of the program's source code (per FSF guidance on
the "GPL output clause"); the golden SVGs are committed under the
same BSD-2-Clause license as the rest of this repo.
